defects.receipt: F-W4:315 '**(b) THE ESCAPES, BOOKED BY BANKED ID — 71 rows on 17 records** <re-based … read 72; fr-ContourPreview KILL-3 re-homed TERMINAL per E6-3>'; F-W4:317 '- **The singles — eight rows on eight records (8)** <re-based … read nine/9>' and, on the same line, 'The nine sum with the eight record-groups above to 20+17+7+7+4+3+3+2+9 = 72'. 20+17+7+7+4+3+3+2 = 63; 63+8 = 71 (header), 63+9 = 72 (sentence). The bullet enumerates nine items of which one — fr-ContourPreview KILL-3 — is struck, leaving eight live. Liveness: grep -c '~~.*The nine sum.*~~' -> 0; grep -c '<sub>[^<]*The nine sum' -> 0. grep -o '= 72' -> 1; grep -o '= 71' -> 0. Mitigation: authoritative figure is in the header immediately above, the list is enumerable in place, and the sentence's own closing clause invites the re-add that catches it. Books nothing; touches no roster, gate or digest.
